title: Born-Preconditioned Learning for Iterative Neural PDE Solvers
summary: Simulating high-frequency waves in spatially varying media remains challenging for both classical iterative methods and neural PDE solvers. We propose Neural Preconditioned Born Series (NPBS), a framework for learning iterative neural PDE solvers. Our guiding idea is to use a simple reference preconditioner to help learn a more effective neural preconditioner. Building on the Convergent Born Series (CBS), NPBS feeds a preconditioned residual to a neural network that predicts a solution update.
